title: 1976-09-15_Dorothy_151.txt
concise_summary: In this densely speculative entry PKD develops his 'polytemporal self' model to explain the 2-3-74 experiences: he argues that a single macro-entity (identified as Zebra/Holy Spirit/Christ) projects multiple temporal selves — Thomas (c. AD 50-70), PKD (1974), and a three-eyed future human — along an axis orthogonal to linear time, all of whom merged during the 3-74 crisis to counter what he frames as a Soviet psychotronic attack. Drawing on Ted Sturgeon's theory of simultaneous lives and his own orthogonal time model, PKD reasons that his novel 'Flow My Tears, the Policeman Said' was co-authored by three polytemporal selves who inserted coded material from distinct temporal vantage points. The entry moves between three explanatory hypotheses — future-self retroactive intervention, timeless macro-entity action, and both together — ultimately settling on a synthesis in which the macro-mind (Zebra, the Holy Spirit) orchestrates all the polytemporal selves simultaneously and this orchestration may itself be the Parousia.
key_claims: The 2-3-74 event was a 'summit conflict' between sophisticated Soviet psychotronic technology and a superior intervention from PKD's future self or the macro-entity.

PKD did not merely have a past life as Thomas; he IS Thomas (c. AD 50) now, existing in a separate spatial compartment whose barrier broke down in 3-74, producing a 'triple exposure' of three simultaneous selves.
Zebra, the macro-mind, is an ultra-terrestrial discorporate plasmatic entity identical with the Holy Spirit and Christ, which acts in symbiosis with chosen humans to make them 'polyforms of Christ.'
Three polytemporal selves collaborated on 'Flow My Tears': the 'Acts' material was inserted by the Thomas-self (past), the dream material by the future self, and PKD's ordinary self was the vessel.
Track transfer between alternative worlds (A, B, C, as described in PKD's Metz speech) is the linear-time experience of what is, from an orthogonal-time standpoint, simultaneous coaxial worlds.

The early Christians practiced a superphysics of anamnesis that allowed them to connect their polytemporal selves into a supratemporal unity — the very technology Christ and the Holy Spirit taught them.
recurring_concepts: Orthogonal time: the axis perpendicular to linear time along which coaxial worlds are simultaneously stacked
Polytemporal self / macro-entity: a single discorporate intelligence that projects multiple temporal selves across history
Zebra: PKD's name for the macro-mind as externally perceived, an ultra-terrestrial plasmatic life form
VALIS: referenced as the superior future technology that countered the Soviet psychotronic attack in 3-74
Track transfer: movement between alternative timeline tracks (A, B, C) accompanied by amnesia
Anamnesis: the early Christian practice of recovering memory across temporal selves to achieve supratemporal unity
Symbiosis: the relationship between the Holy Spirit/macro-entity and chosen humans through which they become polyforms of Christ
The Xerox Missive: the threatening document that triggered PKD's future-self intervention in March 1974
Tachyons: posited carrier mechanism for future-to-past information transmission, later superseded by the macro-mind/Quelle hypothesis
The Parousia / time of the Presence: the eschatological event that may be identical with the polytemporal merging of 3-74
people_entities: Thomas: PKD's apostolic-era alter-identity, a first-century Christian PKD identifies as a simultaneous self living c. AD 50-70
Ted Sturgeon: science fiction writer (Theodore Sturgeon) whose theory of simultaneous polytemporal lives PKD adopts as his framework
Scott Apel: named alongside Ted Sturgeon as having noticed the simultaneous 'former' and 'later' lives pattern in PKD's work
Jeter: likely K.W. Jeter, PKD's friend and fellow SF writer, cited as believing in the symbiosis model
Olive Holt: mentioned briefly in connection with a Cabella printout; identity unclear but associated with PKD's 3-74 milieu
Christ / Jesus: identified as the macro-entity or the sole macro-mind that injects itself into temporal forms
Holy Spirit: identified as the manifestation of the macro-entity through which early Christians were enabled to connect polytemporal selves
texts_works: Acts of the Apostles: biblical text whose material PKD believes his Thomas-self encoded in 'Flow My Tears'
The Book of Acts / 'Acts' material: PKD's shorthand for apostolic-era content coded into his fiction
Ted Sturgeon's theory of the circle of time / simultaneous lives (referenced as 'Sturgeon's model' and 'Ted Sturgen's theny'; no specific title given)
PKD's Metz speech: his 1977 address at Metz, France, in which he outlined tracks A, B, and C and alternative worlds (referenced as already given)
autobiographical: On Wednesday March 20 (1974) the Xerox Missive arrived — a threatening document PKD believed triggered his future-self's intervention and the 'script-breaking' of his life track.
The following Saturday night PKD experienced the 'Bradbury stimulus,' reacting to it in advance — evidence, he argues, that his future personality had already taken over.
On the Friday between the two events PKD saw the 'Cabella printout' connected to Olive Holt.
During 3-74 PKD experienced superimposition of three selves: he saw koine Greek text and Syrian imagery, experienced the Romans, and was temporarily 'taken over' by Thomas.
PKD describes experiencing his California 1974 life 'as a past life' — in a mode where it had all already happened, including the post-mortem portion — which he had previously been unable to explain.

PKD recalls that he suddenly switched to drinking beer, began calling all dogs 'he' and all cats 'she,' and knew how to drive but reacted to the wrong location for the air vent — behavioral anomalies he attributes to a simultaneous contemporary polyself.
PKD references a goldfish necklace that had a significant effect on him, which he now explains through his simultaneous life as a first-century apostolic Christian.
PKD states he 'bumbled in and out of understanding' during an interview in which Ted Sturgeon reviewed 'Flow My Tears' and its multiple worlds.
theological_motifs: Parousia: the Second Coming / time of the Presence, which PKD suggests may be identical with the polytemporal merging event of 3-74
Theolepsy: divine seizure or possession — PKD uses this term for the Holy Spirit descending on Thomas
Anamnesis: Platonic/Christian recollection of prior knowledge, here used for recovering polytemporal self-memory
Resurrection and eternal life: understood as the macro-entity's promise that derives from its ability to contain all temporal selves simultaneously
Gnosis: direct experiential knowledge of the polytemporal self and the macro-entity, which Thomas possesses through the Holy Spirit

Mystery religions / Eleusinians: PKD speculates that mystery cults beginning with the Eleusinians disclosed the simultaneity of coaxial lives; psychedelics may have broken down temporal compartmentalization
Symbiosis with the Holy Spirit: the relationship through which chosen humans (and possibly animals) are made into polyforms of Christ
The macro-entity as sole divine being: PKD speculates there may be only one macro-entity that injects itself into all temporal forms across history
literary_self_ref: PKD argues that 'Flow My Tears, the Policeman Said' was co-authored by three of his polytemporal selves: Acts-era material came from Thomas, dream material from the future self, and PKD was the vessel — even he 'could not account for the substitution of worlds' when he wrote it.
PKD speculates there was an alternate track in which 'Tears' was published without the Acts material, or with different content, and contact between the selves was therefore not made.

PKD states that once the dream material in 'Tears' was published, his future self knew it could reach him and alter the past — the novel functioned as an intersubjective communication channel across time.
PKD confirms the track A, B, C model he described in his Metz speech is validated by this polytemporal framework: the coaxial worlds of 'Tears' will eventually be scientifically explicable.
PKD notes that Ted Sturgeon reviewed 'Tears,' recognized its multiple worlds, and realized PKD had been 'bumbling in and out of understanding' of what he himself had written.
symbols_images: Triple exposure: PKD's photographic metaphor for the superimposition of three simultaneous selves (Thomas, PKD 1974, future self) visible all at once
Coaxial worlds mounted on an orthogonal axis: the geometric image of simultaneous lives stacked along a perpendicular axis like sheaths on a rod
Spatial compartments: PKD images each temporal self as occupying a distinct spatial 'compartment,' whose walls dissolved in 3-74
The goldfish necklace: a physical object that triggered PKD's recognition of his Thomas-self, explained by his simultaneous apostolic Christian identity
Tesla transmitter / Tesla coil: PKD's image for the magnitude of Soviet psychotronic technology that necessitated the macro-entity's intervention
The phosphene 'microwave psycho-energetics' beam: the sensory phenomenon PKD reframes as coming from the future rather than from Soviet technology
Plasmatic energy: the form of the discorporate macro-entity Zebra, for whom 'all things are one'
The Quelle (German: 'source'): PKD uses this term for the macro-mind as the channel through which future selves transmit information to the past, bypassing tachyons
The Black Iron Prison (BIP) and Palm Tree Garden (PTG): PKD pairs these as past-life and future-life experiential worlds respectively, noting he was once in the BIP and may later inhabit the PTG
tensions: PKD offers three competing explanations for 3-74 (future temporal self, timeless macro-entity, both) and cannot definitively choose between them, ultimately settling on option 3 but with stated uncertainty.

PKD simultaneously frames Zebra as an external entity he 'saw externally' and as the inner Holy Spirit acting through and within him — the distinction between transcendent and immanent divine keeps collapsing.
PKD cannot determine whether tachyons or the macro-mind/Quelle is the correct mechanism for future-to-past information transmission, and proposes both without resolving the conflict.
PKD states Thomas is 'c. AD 50' in one passage and 'AD 70' in another, showing inconsistency in the date of the Thomas-self's temporal location.
PKD speculates a 'Soviet national' might be the contemporary parallel polyself, but this remains purely speculative and sits uneasily with the theological framework.

PKD cannot fully explain why his 1974 California life felt like a past life that had already happened — he says this is something he 'has never been able to explain before,' then attempts three explanations without closure.
The claim that all polytemporal selves 'merged in 3-74' to help PKD is asserted strongly but then hedged: 'I'm going for broke + say, probably' — a rare moment of explicit epistemic humility.
evidence_quotes: I must grasp + understand this: I wasn't Thomas in a past life; I am Thomas (c. AD 50) now - like in another spacial compartment [..] that compartment broke through - I saw koine, Syria - I experienced the Romans + knew the Koine. The divisor (barrier) between [..] Thomas, + at least 1 "future" self broke down + they superimposed, triple exposure. No doubt of it.

Zebra is the macro mind, an UTI - ultra terrestrial life form, discorporate: plasmatic energy, for whom all things are one. To Xtians it is known as the Holy Spirit, + those humans (+ animals?) which it acts in symbiosis with are made into polyforms of Christ.
It's as if all my lives [got] together to handle the 3-74 problem, + that points to the "injecting macro entity."
So once more "Tears" appears involved in all this. Even I, the author, when I wrote it, could not account for the substitution of worlds. I knew about track-hopping, wrote about it at the time - but
Future selves were working backward to our time via the macromind, + perhaps pastimes were doing so, also (if this be true then it was perhaps the Parousia, the time of the Presence).
uncertainty_flags: PKD dates Thomas alternately as 'c. AD 50' and 'AD 70' — a factual inconsistency in the identity of the Thomas-self's historical period.
The identity of 'Olive Holt' and the 'Cabella printout' is unclear; these may be people or documents from PKD's 3-74 immediate circle but are not explained.

The reference to 'Ted Sturgen's theny' (theory) is clearly Ted Sturgeon, but PKD also mentions 'Scott Apel' in a single phrase as co-noticing the simultaneous lives; the source text for Sturgeon's theory is not named.

PKD's Metz speech is referenced as already given and known, but the precise date of the speech creates a chronological puzzle: PKD gives this speech in 1977 but the Exegesis entry is dated September 1976 — the speech is referred to in the past tense, suggesting either the dating of this segment is wrong or PKD is conflating with a different talk.
The 'Bradbury stimulus' is mentioned but not identified — it is unclear whether this refers to Ray Bradbury the author or another referent.
PKD's speculation that a Soviet national might be a contemporary parallel polyself is entirely ungrounded and may reflect paranoid ideation rather than theological reasoning.

The phrase 'in the previous go-around for me (PKD) without this symbiosis. I was done in' implies a prior cycle or incarnation where PKD failed — this cyclical cosmology is introduced but not developed.

Contact wasn't made.. Maybe the other coded material (e.g. "Acts") was in [the] recollection. From Thomas' mind. The future self saw that + guessed correctly that Thomas + I were (+ it, too) one that we had an extratemporal entity, here, of which it will be a part (is a part). (It could contain my memories as I contain Thomas') The simultaniety of lives might fit with my orthogonal time model. I must grasp + understand this: I wasn't Thomas in a past life; I am Thomas (c. AD 50) now - like in another spacial compartment [..] that compartment broke through - I saw koine, Syria - I experienced the Romans + knew the Koine. The divisor (barrier) between [..] Thomas, + at least 1 "future" self broke down + they superimposed, triple exposure. No doubt of it. ---------- This life, Calif 1974 (1978) as a past life; I experienced this life in a different mode, as it all of it had already happened, + even the post mortem part. (Which I've never been able to explain before.) That's why I've long had the [..sion] that my go - around with the Xerox Missive was not for the first time. I (still) claim that 1974 as the past was altered, inc. my response to the Xerox Missive. But there really are two possible explanations: 1) a future temporal self intervened retroactively in time. or: 2) A (the) timeless macro-entity intervened. or 3) both were present, which explains why Thomas was there, too, from 50 AD Koine. He came with the macro self; [..] was/is my major temporal "injection." (Since, according to my theory, the early Xtians had learned to make up - connect by anamnesis - these several temporal personalities as one, as a supratemporal one: this was what Christ [..] the Holy Spirit taught + enabled them to do. This (Ted Sturgeon's theny) is the superphysics the Xtians were into. This is why he could promise resurrection + eternal life - with him, maybe he is the sole macro entity, of us all, which injects itself into temporal forms - + forgets? The manifestation (intervention, memory) of a future life does not prove Ted Sturgen's theory of the circle of [time] correct, but it gives weight to the argument. I can reason that a linear future me intervened backwards in time, inserted material in "Tears" etc, but that doesn't explain Thomas or why I found myself in both "my" 1974 world + "his" AD 70 world. So I think Ted is correct. It's as if all my lives [got] together to handle the 3-74 problem, + that points to the "injecting macro entity." ---------- I have to get perspective on this. The Ted Sturgen - Scott Apel notice of simultaneous "former" + "later" lives is absolutely the explanation of why 1) I saw Rome; 2) believed I was in danger from the Romans; 3) heard the koine; 4) was taken over by "Thomas." Either another of the simultaneous lives broke through to me or I broke through to it. + part of the theory is that the full script of each of the selected lives is known to the macro mind before it [injected] itself into it. Suppose there was a PKD who merely began a normal [..] time life in 1928 - + lived it out to its end. Then a macro entity injected itself into this life (as well as past + future [ones]; e.g. Thomas, the 3-eyed evolved humans, etc) +, in symbiosis, as [Jeter] believes, worked with me, surfacing to take full control in 3-74 (But it was there back when I was in high school, + later, too). [..] this macro entity runs a number of lives spread out along the linear time line in sequence, but, for it, simultaneously. Either I was bailed out by the macro entity or by other lives, past + future Christianity is involved; the macro mind - which I saw externally as Zebra - is Christ, in any case, I am one part of either a supratemporal macro intelligence's or a poly temporal intelligence. I'm not "the only game in town," the only entry in the race. But it is not PKD who is this, PKD normally only has knowledge of this one "entry" in the race, [Diagram] Macro mind → (Thomas AD 70) → (PKD 1974) → (Future) There may be several or even many more, or a few more - but I'm sure of 3. It is also possible for the macro mind to operate more than one subform in the same linear time continuum. (Thus explaining why I suddenly switched to beer, called all dogs he + all cats she, knew how to drive a car but reacted in the wrong place for the air vent.) (Suppose - just suppose - the other linear-time contemporary is a Soviet national.) A future self wouldn't have to transmit to me via such external carriers as tachyons; it, knowing above all this. Could / would do so via the Quelle: the macro mind. Maybe the future of the polytemporal lives would be testing this theory out. When the dream material appeared in "Tears" it would know it (he or she) was me - + the Acts' material would disclose "Thomas" as well. So the "Acts" material came from a past self + the dream material from a future one. 3 of the polytemporal selves collaborated on "Tears." Maybe "Tears" originally was published with only the "Acts" material cooked into it. The future self figured out about me + Thomas - + either also figured out about its relation to us or suspected it. To that it, it would have to work via the macro mind - tachyon carried material would get info back to the past, which is a heavy thought, but I think this future self wanted to establish contact with itself specifically. Zebra is the macro mind, an UTI - ultra terrestrial life form, discorporate: plasmatic energy, for whom all things are one. To Xtians it is known as the Holy Spirit, + those humans (+ animals?) which it acts in symbiosis with are made into polyforms of Christ. It sanctifies those whom it chooses - + it is it which does the choosing. It chose the original 12 + is still choosing. Anyhow, the simultaneity of times opens up, finally, an absolutely certain, proper explanation. Coaxial worlds, as I [..] called them. Mounted along an axis orthogonal to linear time. I guess they, although sequential in linear time, occupy the same space as the same orthogonal time; they are all here spacially as well as (from the standpoint of the polytemporal viewer) temporally - all superimposed. I guess the mystery religions - starting with the Elyseans - discloses this. Psychedelics may have been used to break down the temporal compartmentalization. For instance, Thomas, "back" in AD 70, has experienced a life - his life - 2000 years in the (his) future. Him occupying me + trusting me (PKD) aside is just one side of the coin. The other is the experience, knowledge (gnosis) + certitude of immortality which the macro entity, the Holy Spirit, gave him. I'm going for broke + say, probably all the polytemporal personalities merged in 3-74 to give aid in the [3-75] trap situation. Perhaps this equals the macro entity. I guess in the previous go-around for me (PKD) without this symbiosis. I was done in. + I must not forget the general historic intervention. Future selves were working backward to our time via the macromind, + perhaps pastimes were doing so, also (if this be true then it was perhaps the Parousia, the time of the Presence). Sturgeon speaks of one being trapped by the power. Perhaps I was trapped (with amnesia) + so needed the help of the other polyselves. Anyhow, using Sturgeon's model, it is clearly evident why the Gold Fish necklace had the effect on me that it did - given my simultaneous life as an apostolic Xtian of the First Century. Since the Holy Spirit had entered (into symbiosis with) those early, authentic Xtians, "Thomas" could be regarded as the erleben of all the polyselves. Then in a sense the rest of us are forms of him; our route to self knowledge lies through him + what he knows (because of the Holy Spirit decending over him in theolepsy). So being taken over by Thomas would amount to being taken over by the Holy Spirit, since he + it became one (+ the Holy Spirit is a manifestation of God, the One). There is an aggagate personality compounded of out (or many? several?) of the polyselves of one particular macro entity (there may be only one). Anyhow a plurality of selves met the Xerox Missive head on, + one or more saw it from the future looking back, or anyhow from a standpoint where that script had been completed. Not, as to the Bradbury "out of synch": that points conclusively to at least one polyself from the future in relation to which my entire life had (inc. the arrival of the Bradbury stimulus PKD had been pre-empted by a future self or the supratemporal macroself. If the BIP was from the past, then I bet that the PTG was a future polyself: its world. Just as I was once in the BIP, later (to use linear time terms) I could live a life in the PTG. All this indicates that I was absolutely right [..] my Metz speech about tracks A, B, + C. What I did not realize is that arranges along the linear-time axis. They are sequential, but (as I said in the speech) they are alternatives in orthogonal time, + when we move from one to another we suffer amnesia re the one or ones we had been inhabiting. This "track transfer" when viewed as Ted Sturgeon views it coincides with the several worlds of "Tears" which Ted reviewed, + from which (if not also from my previous works) he realized, as he said in the interview I kept bumbling in + out of an understanding of. It is quite possible that a time (linear) will come in which a scientific knowledge will exists by which the coaxial worlds of "Tears" can be readily understood + explained. So once more "Tears" appears involved in all this. Even I, the author, when I wrote it, could not account for the substitution of worlds. I knew about track-hopping, wrote about it at the time - but
